rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JELpirofor
Exhibition name: White Success
rows.Origin: Bred by Robert G. Jelly (United States, 1985).
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. None / no fragrance. 55 petals. Large bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Heat tolerant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 5,632 on 14 Jan 1986 VIEW USPTO PATENT
A new variety of tea rose distinguished by its very large, fully double

white flowers borne on strong, fairly long stems, the blooming habit being

abundant and continuous in greenhouse, the plant having a particularly

vigorous vegetation and growth habit particularly suitable for greenhouse

production for cut flowers.
